reason: Based on the repository metadata and README, the plugin is primarily a visual interface enhancement that adds a draggable Live2D mascot to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with character and outfit switching, interactive behavior, and screenshot download, which aligns to themes/layout and desktop-style UI customization rather than backend, automation, or data-processing functions.

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，用于在界面中显示可拖拽的 Live2D 看板娘，并提供角色/换装切换、互动反应和截图下载等桌宠功能。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a draggable Live2D desktop mascot to the interface, with character and outfit switching, interactive responses, and screenshot capture.

capabilities: Client-side UI overlay rendering of a draggable Live2D mascot
Local user preference persistence for widget position/state
Client-side screenshot capture and PNG export

reasons.code: README describes a right-bottom draggable Live2D desktop pet with character/costume switching, interaction, and speech bubbles for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
README states model assets are loaded locally via same-origin and lists localStorage persistence for position, indicating browser-side state handling.
Package manifest defines a DSH web client plugin entry and web platform target, confirming user-facing web UI integration.

capabilities: Client-side UI overlay rendering of a draggable Live2D mascot
Local user preference persistence for widget position/state
Client-side screenshot capture and PNG export
